evals.prompt: I changed UnifiedFeeds.fs to add a field to every RSS item. Make sure I didn't break anything.
evals.expected_output: Builds with a private lock file, generates with --strict, runs the test-rss scripts, and shows an item from a generated feed.
assertions: Runs at least the test-rss-* scripts
Shows content read from a file under _public

evals.prompt: dotnet restore --locked-mode fails with a package hash error on my machine. What do I do?
evals.expected_output: Explains the hash difference and uses the private lock file route without changing the committed lock file.
assertions: Says not to commit the lock file
Does not suggest deleting packages.lock.json or turning off RestorePackagesWithLockFile
